## Author Checklist

- [ ] The title and description make the intent clear
- [ ] Relevant issues are linked
- [ ] This pull request addresses one issue
- [ ] I read my own diff end to end and reviewed it as though someone else wrote it
- [ ] I built and tested this branch, including functionality the change could affect
- [ ] Code is formatted and CI passes
